issues.title: Incorrect table reference
issues.problem: The query references a table 'users' which does not exist in the provided schema.
issues.fix: Replace 'users' with the correct table name, likely 'sigma_analytics.fact_transactions'.

issues.title: Incorrect WHERE clause
issues.problem: The 'WHERE' clause is incorrectly placed before the 'FROM' clause.
issues.fix: Move the 'WHERE' clause after the 'FROM' clause.

issues.title: Missing join with dim_merchant
issues.problem: The query does not join with the 'dim_merchant' table to get merchant names.
issues.fix: Add a JOIN clause to include 'dim_merchant'.

issues.title: Potential performance issue
issues.problem: Using SELECT * can lead to performance issues by fetching unnecessary columns.
issues.fix: Specify only the required columns in the SELECT clause.

issues.title: Lack of comments
issues.problem: The query lacks comments explaining the logic or purpose.
issues.fix: Add comments to explain the purpose and logic of the query.

review.corrected_sql: SELECT ft.transaction_id, ft.amount, ft.status, ft.merchant_id, dm.merchant_name, ft.customer_id, ft.transaction_date, ft.payment_method FROM sigma_analytics.fact_transactions ft JOIN sigma_analytics.dim_merchant dm ON ft.merchant_id = dm.merchant_id WHERE ft.status = 'COMPLETED';
review.summary: The query had critical correctness issues and lacked readability. The corrected query now includes the necessary join and specifies the required columns.
